description: National Medicines Regulatory Authority - The Medicines registered with the National Medicines Regulatory Authority
categorisation: This gazette content is an order issued under the National Medicines Regulatory Authority Act, No. 5 of 2015, which constitutes a regulatory matter. It publishes a list of registered medicines with their specifications, which falls under legal/regulatory framework and compliance requirements for pharmaceutical products. The content does not involve government structure/personnel, land, commercial registrations, elections, public service, judicial matters, or other specialized categories, making it a clear example of Legal/Regulatory classification.
